Available MCP Tools

Five native read-only tools adhering to the Model Context Protocol standard.

Tool 01

garmin_status

Check presence and local validity of session tokens without any network roundtrip.

params: none
Tool 02

garmin_daily

Fetch daily health summaries, granular sleep phases, resting HR, stress, and body battery.

params: day, metric
Tool 03

garmin_activities

List recent workouts with pagination, sport types, distance, and duration metrics.

params: start, limit
Tool 04

garmin_activity

Deep-dive into a specific activity with split times, elevation, and lap-by-lap heart rate.

params: activity_id
Tool 05

garmin_trends

Extract historical time series from 1 to 31 days with automatic average calculations.

params: start_date, end_date

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I connect directly from the web browser? +

No. The MCP server runs locally as a native stdio child process. This web page provides documentation and installation commands: execution happens solely on your personal computer.

Where are my credentials and biometric data stored? +

Your credentials are never sent to third-party servers. Login takes place directly between your terminal and Garmin Connect. Access tokens are stored in ~/.garmin-mcp with strict permissions (0700/0600).

Which AI clients are supported? +

Officially supports Claude Desktop (macOS & Windows) as well as Codex or any client compatible with the Model Context Protocol stdio specification.

Can this server modify or delete my data on Garmin Connect? +

Never. The server is strictly read-only: it provides zero APIs or capabilities to write, upload, modify, or erase data on Garmin Connect.

Installation Instructions

  1. Run the quickstart command inside your local terminal.
    curl -fsSL https://garmin-mcp-connect.enricoarmiento.chatgpt.site/downloads/install.sh | bash
  2. Log in to Garmin Connect entering your email, password, and MFA code if prompted.
  3. Relaunch Claude Desktop or Codex to register the new MCP server tools.
